newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan blue chips help push index sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan blue chips help push index sharply higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended sharply higher on Monday on overseas buying interest in blue chips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
Dealer Rony Byramjee attributed the rise to buying by multinational fund managers.
"Stock prices are likely to rise further on Tuesday's settlement day," she added.
The Karachi 100-index ended 21.56 points, or 1.23 percent, up at 1,773.29 with 136 losers and 101 gainers.
PSO jumped 10 rupees to 390, Pakistan Telecom PTCA.KA 0.50 to 35.70, ICI Pakistan 1.05 to 27.55 and HUBCO 0.85 to 49.70.
